description-BaseJetstreamStrength: Strength multiplier of the base west-to-east jetstream flow.
description-JetstreamMeanderAmplitude: Maximum meander of the jetstream bearing, in radians. 0 = perfectly straight east.
description-JetstreamMeanderFrequency: (logarithmic) Frequency of the jetstream meander: higher makes the bearing snake more across north/south distance and evolve faster over time.
description-JetstreamNoiseAmplitude: Amplitude of the slow jet-streak speed noise. Gives faster/slower jet segments. 0 = constant.
description-PressureWindStrength: (logarithmic) How strongly wind flows down the pressure gradient (high to low). 0 disables pressure-driven wind.
description-FrontWindStrength: Extra wind speed added by pressure fronts on top of vanilla's wind. 0 = wind is purely vanilla's speed in our direction.
description-SeasonalBias: Shift the westerly bias north/south with the seasons: poleward in summer, equatorward in winter.
description-SeasonalBiasMaxAngleDeg: Maximum north/south tilt of the westerly at peak summer/winter, in degrees.
description-LowSpawnRatePerDay: Average number of low-pressure systems spawned per game day. Low pressure systems lead to stormier skies.
description-HighSpawnRatePerDay: Average number of high-pressure systems spawned per game day. High pressure systems lead to clearer skies.
description-CellRadiusMin: (logarithmic) Minimum pressure-cell influence radius, in meters.
description-CellRadiusMax: (logarithmic) Maximum pressure-cell influence radius, in meters.
description-CyclonicInflowAngleDeg: Cyclonic inflow/outflow tilt of circulation around a pressure cell, in degrees.
description-CirculationStrength: How strongly wind swirls around pressure systems. Higher = stronger, more obvious rotation around lows/highs.
description-MaxActiveCells: Maximum number of pressure systems active at once; new spawns and thermal seeds are skipped while at this cap.
description-StormCouplingStrength: How strongly low pressure biases weather toward storms. 0 disables coupling.
description-WeatherPressureCoupling: How strongly the weather feeds back onto pressure: clear skies raise a cell's pressure (toward high), clouds lower it (toward low), and storms lower it strongly (deep low). 0 disables the weather/pressure feedback system.
description-FrontTemperatureMax: Maximum °C a pressure system shifts local temperature toward its own air mass's character (warm or cold, independent of low/high). 0 disables front temperature.
description-ThermalTemperatureMax: Maximum °C the terrain-thermal field shifts local temperature. 0 disables terrain temperature.
description-HeatColdWaveEnabled: Allow rare, strong, near-stationary heat-wave/cold-wave highs to form over terrain thermal hotspots, pushing local temperature 5-10°C outside the seasonal average for several days.
description-CloudsFollowWind: Make clouds drift along the true wind direction.
description-AltitudePressureDrop: Fractional pressure drop reached at the build ceiling. Pressure falls with altitude toward 'low'; no effect at/below sea level.
description-AdvectWithWind: Advect pressure cells along the local wind instead of a fixed jetstream velocity.
description-AdvectionSpeed: Cell drift speed in meters per game-hour per unit of wind strength. Higher = pressure systems travel faster.
description-DispersalRate: How fast cells spread out and fade over their life. 0 = no dispersal.
description-BernoulliStrength: Bernoulli coupling: faster-moving air lowers local pressure, stagnant air raises it. 0 disables speed/pressure feedback.
description-ThermalSeeding: Spawn mobile, dispersing pressure cells from terrain thermal hotspots so terrain influence drifts with the wind.
description-ThermalStaticScale: How much of the raw terrain thermal field stays as a static, terrain-pinned baseline. 1 = fully static, 0 = fully mobile.
description-OrographicEnabled: Let terrain slow and deflect wind.
description-OrographicHeightThreshold: Terrain height (meters) above which wind starts to slow.
description-OrographicSlowdownFactor: Maximum fractional wind slowdown over the highest terrain.
description-OrographicDeflectionStrength: How strongly terrain gradients deflect/curve the wind around obstacles.
description-OrographicWakeFactor: Wind speed loss in the sheltered lee of higher terrain.
description-OcclusionEnabled: Sharply reduce wind speed indoors, underground, or anywhere else sheltered from open sky.
description-OcclusionRoomsZeroWind: Fully enclosed rooms (cellars, greenhouses, sealed buildings) get zero wind, even if a glass roof lets sunlight through.
description-OcclusionLightThreshold: Sun-exposure light level at/above which a spot counts as fully open (unshielded).
description-OcclusionSharpness: How sharply wind falls off as shielding increases. Higher values keep near-open spots at near-full speed and only cut hard once mostly enclosed.
description-OcclusionMinFactor: Wind speed fraction retained in a fully sealed, sunless space. 0 = dead calm.
description-WindmillDirectionality: Scale windmill power by how well the wind aligns with the rotor axle.
description-WindmillMinEfficiency: Minimum directional efficiency floor so mills don't fully stall when wind is perpendicular to the axle. 0 = can stall completely.
description-SailboatEnabled: Make sailboat speed depend on wind direction relative to heading.
description-SailboatTailwindMaxBoost: Fractional speed boost with a pure tailwind.
description-SailboatHeadwindMaxPenalty: Fractional speed penalty sailing straight into the wind.
description-DopplerRadarMapLayerVisibleB: Show or hide the precipitation radar map layer by default
description-FrontMapLayerVisibleByDefaul: Show or hide the weather fronts map layer by default
description-WindDirectionMapLayerVisible: Show or hide the wind direction and speed map layer by default
description-RotorvaneSpeedMult: Higher numbers make the rotor vane spin faster
command-debug-description: Print wind direction, speed multiplier and pressure at your position
